candidates.change_summary: Change blockAssertion field from false to true.
Change arbitrateViaEscalationManager field from false to true.
Change discardOracle field from false to true.
Change validateDisputers field from false to true.
Change the return statement from returning true to returning false.
Make the return value depend on the disputeCaller address, returning false for address(0) and true otherwise.
Make getPrice return 1 instead of the implicit default 0.
Delete the event emission so no PriceRequestAdded event is emitted on requestPrice.
Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier so any caller can invoke requestPrice and trigger the event.
Emit the event with time hardcoded to 0 instead of the passed-in time.
Replace the require check with an unconditional revert so requestPrice always reverts.
